reserveReview.rationale: The complete native yield reserve in the newest published scanner snapshot at height 887405, captured 2026-10-17T15:17:42.772Z, is 317174052391262472 ZSD atoms, or 317,174.0523912624 ZSD at 10^12 atoms per unit. That same amount is the complete direct-reserve denominator, establishing one 100% ZSD wrapper slice without an inferred residual or changed category. The snapshot also reports 159541897460093467 circulating ZYS atoms (159,541.8974600935 ZYS) and yield_price 1988029270000 atoms. The pinned protocol source calculates the yield price by dividing the ZSD yield reserve by circulating ZYS and truncating the result; the snapshot's own yield_price is 1988029270000 atoms, which is 0.0003% below the ratio of the two balances reported in the same snapshot, so the published price is not recomputed or rounded here. This review does not assert exact reserve-to-liability reconciliation or independent explorer corroboration. The single-slice composition is unchanged from the October 10 review; only the reserve balance, circulating ZYS and yield price moved. Underlying ZSD collateral and its unresolved factors stay upstream.
